text: Research Question (RQ) How does the use of gamification strategies influence engagement and learningoutcomes among students with diverse user characteristics when using LLM-PATs?• Sub RQ1: How are cognitive, emotional, and behavioral engagement (as defined by [4]) affected by theimplementation of gamification elements in LLM-PAT environments for higher education?• Sub RQ2: How does encouraging university students to learn specific concepts through visual point-and level-based progress tracking influence their learning outcomes in LLM-PAT environments?• Sub RQ3: How does the use of gamification strategies affect engagement differently among studentswith distinct user characteristics in LLM-PAT environments for higher education?
